$comment: Seconds of test time per Node test file, from the Node legs of a pull request's CI run (files that run did not reach keep their earlier Main-run times). Only how scripts/vitest-shard-sequencer.mjs balances legs depends on these numbers; a missing or stale entry never drops or repeats a file. Regenerate from a run's Node legs: gh run view <run> --repo meta/astryx --log > run.log && node scripts/vitest-shard-sequencer.mjs record run.log
